messages:
Anya: Need a quick design sprint for Q3 inbound: landing hero, 3 benchmark tiles, small SDR routing diagram, and webinar hero. Final assets by Friday EOD.
Mira: Got it. What should the benchmark tiles show?
Anya: Metrics: Hosted p50=85ms cost=$0.0025, Dedicated p50=65ms cost=$0.0016, Private p50=72ms cost=$0.0020. Callout: "Most cost-efficient at scale" for Dedicated.
Jackie: Brand rules: new palette (navy/coral/muted-green), Inter scale, flat 2-color icons, simple layout: icon + 3 metrics + 1-line insight.
Sam: Routing logic: score>=60 -> SDR queue + Slack alert; score<60 -> 7-day nurture. Use this YAML for visuals:
```
routes:
  - name: high_intent
    match: score >= 60
    action: send_to_sdr_queue + slack_alert(#sdr-high)
  - name: nurture
    match: score < 60
    action: add_to_drip(days=7)
```
Mira: Deliverables: Figma file (pages for hero/tiles/routing), PNGs 1200x628, 640x360, 1920x1080. US and EU English copy only. First drafts Thu noon, final Fri EOD.
Leo: Legal note: avoid "cheapest". Use "most cost-efficient at scale" and add footnote: "Based on internal Redwood performance tests, June 2025." I'll review Thu afternoon.
design-bot: Checklist made: [Figma master, PNG 1200x628, PNG 640x360, PNG 1920x1080, SVG icons, localizable text layers, export manifest].
Mira: Uploading draft figma link when ready. Post feedback as figma comments please.
Anya: Thanks all 680
